verdict.rationale: Crossplane's own marketing says it puts policies, permissions and guardrails behind custom APIs that AI agents can self-service and "safely act on". It also says it extends Kubernetes RBAC to managed resources, which gives a least-privilege surface for an agent. Beyond that, the only related evidence is offline rendering of compositions, and these are marketing-level claims rather than a documented agent workflow. Missing for 10: a documented plan/diff preview of infrastructure changes before apply, approval or review gates that block unapproved changes, concrete least-privilege configuration guidance for agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
